item.title: Training Children in the Lord: A Biblical Vision for Christian Parenting
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins presents a biblical vision for Christian parenting rooted in Ephesians 6:4. Parents are called to shape their children’s hearts with the gospel, form their character through Scripture, guide behavior with loving discipline, and model daily discipleship in Christ.

item.title: Guarding the Tongue: How Godly Men Speak with Wisdom and Grace
item.description: Scripture teaches that a man’s words reveal the condition of his heart. In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins continues the Men of Resolve series by addressing the biblical call for godly men to exercise self-control, wisdom, and grace in their speech. Drawing from James 3, Proverbs 18:21, and Matthew 12:34, this episode offers biblical teaching and practical help for growing in Christlike speech.

item.title: Psalm 9 Explained: God’s Righteous Justice and Refuge for the Oppressed
item.description: Psalm 9 is a song of thanksgiving and confidence in the righteous rule of God. In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks verse by verse through Psalm 9, highlighting God’s unshakable throne, His refuge for the oppressed, and the certainty of His righteous judgment. Psalm 9 ultimately points to Christ, the righteous Judge who will return in justice.

item.title: The Seven Mountain Mandate: History, Origins, and a Biblical Assessment
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins examines the Seven Mountain Mandate by tracing its historical development, commonly claimed origins, and its shift from cultural engagement into a theology of dominion and control.
